reason: I already invoice brands off my rate card and insights, so I'd try the one free counted collab first, but I'm not paying for a beta tool from a small team I can't verify yet. ₹499 isn't the issue; putting my name on a link I send to a café owner is.
objection: Who actually runs Mitra and is there a registered company behind it? If a café disputes the counts or doesn't pay me, who do I complain to, and will brands outside Bengaluru even trust a 'customers I brought' record from a beta app?
would_change_my_mind: A free counted collab that shows real redemption numbers a brand actually accepts in a rate negotiation, plus a visible company name, GST/registration and a support contact.
